tt0423746.name: Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go!
tt0423746.description:
Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go! is an American/Japanese animated television series, and was created by Ciro Nieli, one of the directors of Teen Titans, with animation being done by a Japanese studio known as The Answer Studio. Set mainly on the fictional planet of Shuggazoom, the series follows the adventures of five cyborg monkeys and a human boy named Chiro as they struggle to protect their planet - and the rest of the universe - from the forces of evil.

As is obvious from the visual appearance of the show, there is a significant anime influence present, despite being produced for American television. tt0114709.description: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.

tt0120363.name: Toy Story 2
tt0120363.description: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz and his friends set out on a rescue mission to save Woody before he becomes a museum toy property with his roundup gang Jessie, Prospector, and Bullseye.

tt0435761.name: Toy Story 3
tt0435761.description: As Andy prepares to leave for college, Woody, Buzz and the gang face an uncertain future when a mix-up sends them to a daycare center full of new toys.

tt0126029.name: Shrek
tt0126029.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

tt0298148.name: Shrek 2
tt0298148.description: Shrek and Fiona travel to the Kingdom of Far Far Away, where Fiona's parents are King and Queen, to celebrate their marriage. When they arrive, they find they are not as welcome as they thought they would be.

tt0441773.name: Kung Fu Panda
tt0441773.description: To everyone's surprise, including his own, Po, an overweight, clumsy panda, is chosen as protector of the Valley of Peace. His suitability will soon be tested as the valley's arch-enemy is on his way.

tt1302011.name: Kung Fu Panda 2
tt1302011.description: Po and his friends fight to stop a peacock villain from conquering China with a deadly new weapon, but first the Dragon Warrior must come to terms with his past.

tt0892769.name: How to Train Your Dragon
tt0892769.description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

tt1001526.name: Megamind
tt1001526.description: The villainous Megamind finally defeats his do-gooder nemesis, Metro Man, but is left without a purpose in a superhero-free world.

tt0351283.name: Madagascar
tt0351283.description: A group of animals who have spent all their life in a New York zoo end up in the jungles of Madagascar, and must adjust to living in the wild.

tt0327084.name: Over the Hedge
tt0327084.description: A scheming raccoon fools a mismatched family of forest creatures into helping him repay a debt of food, by invading the new suburban sprawl that popped up while they were hibernating...and learns a lesson about family himself.

tt0424095.name: Flushed Away
tt0424095.description: The story of an uptown rat that gets flushed down the toilet from his penthouse apartment, ending in the sewers of London, where he has to learn a whole new and different way of life.

tt0312004.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
tt0312004.description: Wallace and his loyal dog, Gromit, set out to discover the mystery behind the garden sabotage that plagues their village and threatens the annual giant vegetable growing contest.

tt0385880.name: Monster House
tt0385880.description: Three teens discover that their neighbor's house is really a living, breathing, scary monster.

tt0327597.name: Coraline
tt0327597.description: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, a young girl discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life that seems too good to be true.

tt0462538.name: The Simpsons Movie
tt0462538.description: After Homer pollutes the town's water supply, Springfield is encased in a gigantic dome by the EPA and the Simpsons are declared fugitives.

tt0472033.description: A rag doll that awakens in a postapocalyptic future holds the key to humanity's salvation.

tt1192628.name: Rango
tt1192628.description: Rango is an ordinary chameleon who accidentally winds up in the town of Dirt, a lawless outpost in the Wild West in desperate need of a new sheriff.

tt0983193.name: The Adventures of Tintin
tt0983193.description: Intrepid reporter Tintin and Captain Haddock set off on a treasure hunt for a sunken ship commanded by Haddock's ancestor.

tt1772341.name: Wreck-It Ralph
tt1772341.description: Ralph is tired of playing the role of a bad guy and embarks on a journey to become a video game hero. But he accidentally lets loose a deadly enemy that threatens the entire arcade.

tt2245084.name: Big Hero 6
tt2245084.description: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who together team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

tt0068112.name: The New Scooby-Doo Movies
tt0068112.description: Each episode features real-life celebrities or well-known fictional characters joining the Mystery, Inc. gang in solving the mystery of the week.

tt8543208.name: Looney Tunes Cartoons
tt8543208.description: A series of short form cartoons starring the iconic and beloved Looney Tunes characters including Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, and Porky Pig in their classic pairings.

tt0084972.name: Alvin and the Chipmunks
tt0084972.description: Three chipmunk brothers, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore are adopted by human songwriter Dave Seville.

tt0051283.name: The Huckleberry Hound Show
tt0051283.description: The classic Hanna-Barbera animated series starring Huckleberry Hound, Yogi Bear and Boo Boo, and Pixie and Dixie and Mr. Jinks.

tt0247902.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters
tt0247902.description: Yugi Moto solves an Ancient Egyptian Puzzle and brings forth a dark and powerful alter ego. Whenever he and his friends are threatened by evil in Duel Monster Card Game, this alter ego breaks out to save them.

tt0103369.name: Sailor Moon
tt0103369.description: Usagi Tsukino is a clumsy teenager who transforms into the magical guardian Sailor Moon to defend Earth and the galaxy alongside her fellow Sailor Senshi.

tt0233033.name: The Berenstain Bears
tt0233033.description: The adventures and life lessons of Brother and Sister Bear alongside Mama and Papa Bear in Bear Country.

tt3218680.name: Pokémon Origins
tt3218680.description: A faithful four-part animated adaptation of the original Pokémon (Pokemon) Red and Blue video games following Red and his Charmander as they battle rival Blue, Team Rocket, and Mewtwo.

tt0115518.name: Aladdin and the King of Thieves
tt0115518.description: When the Forty Thieves crash Aladdin and Princess Jasmine's wedding in search of the Oracle, Aladdin discovers that the King of Thieves is his long-lost father Cassim.

tt0499605.name: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 3: The Jerkinators!
tt0499605.description: Jimmy Neutron and Timmy Turner accidentally create an unstoppable villain named Shirley who threatens to erase both Retroville and Dimmsdale.

tt0356721.name: The Lion King 1½
tt0356721.description: Timon the meerkat and Pumbaa the warthog fast-forward and rewind through the events of The Lion King to reveal their own hilarious behind-the-scenes story.

tt0325881.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe (2002)
tt0325881.description: Young Prince Adam of Eternia wields the Sword of Power to transform into He-Man, leading the Masters of the Universe against Skeletor, King Hiss, and the Snake Men.

tt2380307.name: Coco
tt2380307.description: Aspiring young musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the vibrant Land of the Dead to unlock the real story behind his family history.

tt1739212.name: Pokémon the Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom
tt1739212.description: Ash and his companions encounter the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Victini and awaken the legendary dragon Zekrom to stop Damon's plan to move the Sword of the Vale.

tt0960751.name: Dinosaur King
tt0960751.description: Max, Rex, and Zoe—the D-Team—travel the globe with their dinosaur partners Chomp, Ace, and Paris to rescue prehistoric dinosaurs from the time-traveling Alpha Gang.

tt0808508.name: Tom and Jerry: Shiver Me Whiskers
tt0808508.description: Aboard the pirate ship of Captain Red, Tom and Jerry find a treasure map to the Spanish Main guarded by a giant octopus and a ghost pirate crew.

tt1446192.name: Rise of the Guardians
tt1446192.description: When the evil spirit Pitch Black launches an assault on the hopes and dreams of children, the immortal Guardians—Santa Claus, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy, and Sandman—recruit Jack Frost.

tt1453405.name: Monsters University
tt1453405.description: Before becoming top scarers at Monsters, Inc., college rivals Mike Wazowski and James P. Sullivan must team up with a fraternity of misfits to win the Scare Games.

tt2294629.name: Frozen
tt2294629.description: When the newly crowned Queen Elsa accidentally uses her power to turn things into ice to curse her home in infinite winter, her sister Anna teams up with Kristoff, Sven, and Olaf.

tt0213897.name: Rurouni Kenshin
tt0213897.description: In Meiji-era Japan, former legendary assassin Himura Kenshin wanders the countryside with a reverse-blade sword, vowing never to kill again while protecting the innocent.

tt2510894.name: Hotel Transylvania 2
tt2510894.description: Now open to human guests, Hotel Transylvania sees Dracula secretly put his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis through a 'monster-in-training' boot camp with his monster pals.

tt0274640.name: Digimon Adventure 02
tt0274640.description: Three years after the original DigiDestined saved the Digital World, Davis, Yolei, Cody, T.K., and Kari use Armor Digivolution and DNA Digivolution to stop the Digimon Emperor.

tt4520988.name: Frozen II
tt4520988.description: Anna, Elsa, Kristoff, Olaf, and Sven leave Arendelle to travel to an ancient, autumn-bound enchanted forest to find the origin of Elsa's magical powers and save their kingdom.

tt2386490.name: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
tt2386490.description: When Toothless discovers an untamed, elusive Light Fury and the ruthless Night Fury hunter Grimmel threatens Berk, Hiccup and Toothless journey to the mythical Hidden World.

tt11165358.name: Adventure Time: Distant Lands
tt11165358.description: Four feature-length Adventure Time specials following BMO in outer space, Marceline and Princess Bubblegum, Peppermint Butler, and Finn and Jake's greatest adventure together.

tt3606756.name: Incredibles 2
tt3606756.description: Elastigirl is recruited to lead a campaign to bring Supers back into the spotlight while Mr. Incredible stays home to care for Violet, Dash, and baby Jack-Jack's emerging powers.

tt3416828.name: Ice Age: Collision Course
tt3416828.description: When Scrat accidentally launches a UFO into outer space and sends a giant asteroid hurtling toward Earth, Buck leads Manny, Sid, and Diego on a mission to stop the impact.

tt1979376.name: Toy Story 4
tt1979376.description: When Bonnie creates a reluctant new toy named Forky out of a spork, Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and the gang embark on a road trip where Woody reunites with Bo Peep.

tt0101414.name: Beauty and the Beast
tt0101414.description: A prince cursed to spend his days as a hideous monster sets out to regain his humanity by earning a young woman's love before the last petal falls from an enchanted rose.

tt2948356.name: Zootopia
tt2948356.description: In a city of anthropomorphic animals, rookie bunny cop Judy Hopps and cynical con-artist fox Nick Wilde must work together to uncover a conspiracy involving missing predators.

tt11696014.name: Pokémon: Twilight Wings
tt11696014.description: Set in the Galar region, this animated Pokémon (Pokemon) miniseries follows the dreams, challenges, and bonds of young trainers and Gym Leaders.

tt0159182.name: Mobile Fighter G Gundam
tt0159182.description: Every four years, the space colonies settle control of the universe through the Gundam Fight tournament on Earth, where martial artist Domon Kasshu pilots the Shining Gundam.

tt2452042.name: The Peanuts Movie
tt2452042.description: Charlie Brown embarks on a quest to impress the Little Red-Haired Girl while his beagle Snoopy takes to the skies to pursue his arch-nemesis, the Red Baron.

tt1216475.name: Cars 2
tt1216475.description: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his tow-truck best friend Mater head overseas for the World Grand Prix, where Mater gets caught up in international espionage with Finn McMissile.

tt3257582.name: Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened
tt3257582.description: When an army of five revived Paleozoic Pokémon (Pokemon) Genesect attacks New Tork City, Mega Mewtwo Y intervenes alongside Ash and Pikachu to stop the destruction.

tt0414177.name: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour
tt0414177.description: When Timmy Turner wishes to be in the greatest lab in the universe, he swaps dimensions with boy genius Jimmy Neutron between Retroville and Dimmsdale.

tt12708542.name: Star Wars: The Bad Batch
tt12708542.description: Clone Force 99, an elite squad of genetically mutated clone troopers, navigates a rapidly changing galaxy in the immediate aftermath of the Clone Wars and Order 66.

tt0100477.name: The Rescuers Down Under
tt0100477.description: Rescue Aid Society mice Bernard and Miss Bianca fly to the Australian Outback aboard Wilbur the albatross to save a young boy named Cody and a giant golden eagle from poacher McLeach.

tt0115329.name: The Real Adventures of Jonny Quest
tt0115329.description: Teenage Jonny Quest, Hadji, Jessie Bannon, Race Bannon, and Dr. Benton Quest investigate global phenomena and cyberspace mysteries inside the virtual world of QuestWorld.

tt0245642.name: The Little Mermaid II: Return to the Sea
tt0245642.description: Ariel and Eric's daughter Melody, kept away from the ocean to protect her from Ursula's vengeful sister Morgana, longs to swim in the sea and is transformed into a mermaid.

tt6144886.name: Beyblade Burst
tt6144886.description: Energetic blader Valt Aoi and his Beyblade Victory Valtryek train with the Beigoma Academy BeyClub to take on rival Shu Kurenai and become the world's top blader.

tt0328880.name: Brother Bear
tt0328880.description: When an impulsive young Inuit hunter named Kenai avenges his brother by killing a bear, the Spirits magically transform him into a bear and pair him with a talkative cub named Koda.

tt1690953.name: Despicable Me 2
tt1690953.description: Now a devoted father to Margo, Edith, and Agnes, former supervillain Gru is recruited by the Anti-Villain League and partnered with Agent Lucy Wilde to stop El Macho.

tt0088528.name: Adventures of the Gummi Bears
tt0088528.description: A secret colony of mythical Gummi Bears in Gummi Glen uses magical Gummiberry Juice to protect the kingdom of Dunwyn from the scheming Duke Igthorn and his ogres.

tt2357291.name: Rio 2
tt2357291.description: Blu, Jewel, and their three kids leave their domesticated life in Rio de Janeiro for an expedition deep into the Amazon rainforest, where Jewel reunites with her long-lost flock.

tt0347791.name: Pokémon Heroes: Latios and Latias
tt0347791.description: In the water-canal city of Alto Mare, Ash and Pikachu befriend the legendary dragon Pokémon (Pokemon) Latios and Latias and defend the Soul Dew from Team Rocket thieves Annie and Oakley.

tt0034492.name: Bambi
tt0034492.description: The story of a young deer growing up in the forest alongside his friends Thumper the rabbit and Flower the skunk after his mother is shot by hunters.

tt1422673.name: Pokémon: Arceus and the Jewel of Life
tt1422673.description: When the Alpha Pokémon (Pokemon) Arceus awakens to judge humanity for an ancient betrayal, Dialga sends Ash, Dawn, and Brock back in time to change history.

tt0389790.name: Bee Movie
tt0389790.description: Fresh out of college, disillusioned honeybee Barry B. Benson befriends New York florist Vanessa and sues the human race after discovering that people have been eating bees' honey.

tt0120131.name: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
tt0120131.description: Simba and Nala's adventurous daughter Kiara falls in love with Kovu, a young lion from the banished Outsider pride raised to avenge Scar, sparking a struggle to unite the Pride Lands.

tt0283426.name: The Jungle Book 2
tt0283426.description: Now living in the Man-Village, Mowgli misses his carefree jungle life with Baloo and sneaks back into the wild, unaware that Shere Khan is waiting for revenge.

tt1674768.name: Tom and Jerry Meet Sherlock Holmes
tt1674768.description: In Victorian London, Tom and Jerry assist legendary detective Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson in clearing singer Red's name after Professor Moriarty steals the crown jewels.

tt1080016.name: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
tt1080016.description: When Sid adopts three Tyrannosaurus eggs and is carried into a lush subterranean dinosaur world, Manny, Ellie, and Diego team up with one-eyed weasel Buck to rescue him.

tt3915174.name: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
tt3915174.description: Discovering that his passion for adventure has burned through eight of his nine lives, Puss in Boots embarks on an epic quest into the Dark Forest to find the mythical Wishing Star.

tt0783598.name: Brother Bear 2
tt0783598.description: Kenai and Koda help Kenai's childhood friend Nita journey to Hokani Falls to burn an amulet and break a childhood bond before her wedding.

tt1587157.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Bonds Beyond Time
tt1587157.description: Three generations of Duel Monsters heroes—Yugi Muto, Jaden Yuki, and Yusei Fudo—unite across time to defeat Paradox and his Malefic dragons.

tt22022452.name: Inside Out 2
tt22022452.description: As Riley enters puberty and heads to high school hockey camp, Headquarters undergoes a sudden demolition to make room for new emotions led by Anxiety, Envy, Ennui, and Embarrassment.

tt5848272.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
tt5848272.description: Six years after saving the arcade, Wreck-It Ralph and Vanellope von Schweetz venture into the uncharted expanse of the Internet via a newly installed Wi-Fi router to find a replacement Sugar Rush wheel.

tt0115286.name: Quack Pack
tt0115286.description: Donald Duck works as a globe-trotting TV cameraman alongside Daisy Duck while raising his now-teenage nephews Huey, Dewey, and Louie.

tt0398286.name: Tangled
tt0398286.description: The magically long-haired Rapunzel has spent her entire life in a hidden tower, but now that a runaway thief named Flynn Rider has stumbled upon her, she is about to discover the world.

tt0937616.name: Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea
tt0937616.description: Ash, May, and Pokémon (Pokemon) Ranger Jack Walker protect the Prince of the Sea, Manaphy, and the ancient Sea Temple Samiya from the pirate Phantom.

tt11847692.name: Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle
tt11847692.description: Deep in the Forest of Okoya, Ash and Pikachu meet Koko, a human boy raised by the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Zarude, and join forces to defend the jungle's healing spring.

tt1646926.name: Open Season 3
tt1646926.description: Boog swaps places with a look-alike circus grizzly bear named Doug and falls for Russian trapeze bear Ursa, prompting Elliot and the woodland crew to stage a rescue.

tt3513498.name: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
tt3513498.description: It's been five years since everything was awesome and the citizens are facing a huge new threat: LEGO DUPLO invaders from outer space, wrecking everything faster than they can rebuild.

tt1701198.name: Pokémon—Zoroark: Master of Illusions
tt1701198.description: Ash and his friends rescue the illusion-casting Pokémon (Pokemon) Zorua and Zoroark in Crown City before media mogul Grings Kodai can steal Celebi's time-ripple energy.

tt0055254.name: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
tt0055254.description: When a litter of Dalmatian puppies are abducted by the minions of Cruella de Vil, the parents Pongo and Perdita must find them before she uses them for a fur coat.

tt0892791.name: Shrek Forever After
tt0892791.description: Longing for the days when he felt like a real ogre, Shrek signs a deceptive pact with Rumpelstiltskin and wakes up in an alternate Far Far Away where he and Fiona never met.

tt2953050.name: Encanto
tt2953050.description: A Colombian teenage girl has to face the frustration of being the only member of her family without magical powers—until she discovers that the magic surrounding the Encanto is in danger.

tt1646971.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
tt1646971.description: Five years after uniting dragons and Vikings on Berk, Hiccup and Toothless discover a secret ice cave, Hiccup's long-lost mother Valka, and the dragon-conquering warlord Drago Bludvist.

tt0448694.name: Puss in Boots
tt0448694.description: Long before meeting Shrek, the notorious outlaw Puss in Boots teams up with mastermind Humpty Dumpty and street-savvy Kitty Softpaws to steal the legendary Golden Goose.

tt5461386.name: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions
tt5461386.description: Set after the original manga, Seto Kaiba excavates the Millennium Puzzle to duel the Pharaoh one last time while a mysterious boy named Aigami wields the Quantum Cube.

tt0423294.name: Surf's Up
tt0423294.description: A behind-the-scenes mockumentary following teenage rockhopper penguin Cody Maverick as he leaves Shiverpool, Antarctica to enter the Big Z Memorial Surf Off on Pen Gu Island.

tt0108990.name: The Tick (1994)
tt0108990.description: A nigh-invulnerable, blue-suited superhero with more enthusiasm than brains teams up with mild-mannered accountant sidekick Arthur to protect The City from bizarre supervillains.

tt0844471.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
tt0844471.description: Eccentric young inventor Flint Lockwood builds a machine that turns water in the atmosphere into raining cheeseburgers and pancakes over the island town of Swallow Falls.

tt1333710.name: Huntik: Secrets & Seekers
tt1333710.description: High school student Lok Lambert joins the Huntik Foundation alongside Dante Vale, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon, summoning ancient Titans to stop the sinister Organization.

tt2549540.name: Pokémon the Movie: Kyurem vs. the Sword of Justice
tt2549540.description: Ash and his friends help the Colt Pokémon (Pokemon) Keldeo rescue the Swords of Justice—Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion—from the fearsome dragon Kyurem.

tt11567160.name: Justice League Dark: Apokolips War
tt11567160.description: After a devastating invasion by Darkseid decimates Earth and the Justice League, the surviving heroes rally around Superman, John Constantine, Raven, and Damian Wayne for a final stand.

tt1156531.name: Tom and Jerry: A Nutcracker Tale
tt1156531.description: In an empty opera house on Christmas Eve, Jerry's wish brings a magical toy kingdom to life until Tom and a band of alley cats invade to Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker score.

tt0460627.name: Pokémon Chronicles
tt0460627.description: Spin-off anthology series of the Pokémon (Pokemon) anime focusing on Brock, Misty, Richie, Tracey, Team Rocket, and legendary Pokémon adventures across Johto and Kanto.

tt0107688.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
tt0107688.description: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, stumbles through a portal to Christmas Town and becomes so enchanted that he decides to kidnap Santa Claus and take over the holiday.

tt3025994.name: Scooby-Doo! Stage Fright
tt3025994.description: Fred and Daphne compete as finalists on the television singing show Talent Star in Chicago while a masked Phantom haunts the historic opera house.

tt7961060.name: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
tt7961060.description: Goku and Vegeta encounter Broly, an exiled Saiyan warrior with limitless latent battle power brought to Earth by Frieza, leading to an earth-shattering clash.

tt0082406.name: The Fox and the Hound
tt0082406.description: An orphaned red fox named Tod and a hound puppy named Copper form a deep childhood friendship that is tested when they grow up into natural enemies.

tt1436562.name: Rio
tt1436562.description: Domesticated Spix's macaw Blu, who never learned to fly in Minnesota, is taken to Rio de Janeiro to meet the fiercely independent Jewel and escape animal smugglers.

tt5216936.name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
tt5216936.description: Count Dracula and his monster family embark on a luxury monster cruise ship vacation, unaware that the ship's captain Ericka is the descendant of Abraham Van Helsing.

tt0279077.name: FLCL
tt0279077.description: Twelve-year-old Naota Nandaba's boring suburban life is turned upside down when Vespa-riding alien Haruko Haruhara hits him with a bass guitar, causing giant robots to sprout from his forehead.

tt0875609.name: Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
tt0875609.description: When Pikachu is spirited away to the Tree of Beginning by Mew, Ash awakens Sir Aaron's Aura Pokémon (Pokemon) Lucario to journey into the ancient crystal cavern.

tt0396555.name: Meet the Robinsons
tt0396555.description: Orphaned twelve-year-old boy inventor Lewis is whisked away to the year 2037 by Wilbur Robinson to stop the Bowler Hat Guy from altering the future.

tt0316521.name: Cyborg 009
tt0316521.description: Nine people kidnapped from around the world and turned into superhuman cyborgs by the Black Ghost organization rebel against their creators to protect humanity.

tt0365737.name: Mulan II
tt0365737.description: Newly engaged Mulan and General Li Shang escort three Chinese princesses to a diplomatic marriage alliance while Mushu schemes to keep Mulan from losing him as her guardian.

tt0420076.name: Pokémon: Jirachi - Wish Maker
tt0420076.description: Awakening for only seven days every thousand years when the Millennium Comet appears, the Wish Pokémon (Pokemon) Jirachi bonds with Max and must be saved from a rogue magician.

tt0088631.name: ThunderCats (1985)
tt0088631.description: Fleeing their dying home planet of Thundera, young Lord Lion-O and the noble ThunderCats—Tygra, Panthro, Cheetara, WilyKit, WilyKat, and Snarf—wield the Sword of Omens against Mumm-Ra on Third Earth.

tt5628740.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
tt5628740.description: Inside the virtual reality network LINK VRAINS, teenage hacker Yusaku Fujiki transforms into Playmaker and teams up with sentient AI Ignis to battle the Knights of Hanoi.

tt5889204.name: Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel
tt5889204.description: Bound together by a magnetic chain, Ash and the Steam Pokémon (Pokemon) Volcanion storm the clockwork Azoth Kingdom to rescue the artificial Soul-Heart Pokémon Magearna.

tt0438097.name: Ice Age: The Meltdown
tt0438097.description: Manny, Sid, and Diego discover that the warming climate is about to flood their valley and set out toward higher ground along with Ellie, a female mammoth who thinks she's a possum.

tt1037011.name: Ben 10: Race Against Time
tt1037011.description: Returning home from summer vacation, Ben Tennyson must stop the interdimensional alien warlord Eon from unlocking the Hands of Armageddon and taking over the Omnitrix.

tt10474606.name: We Bare Bears: The Movie
tt10474606.description: When their love of food trucks and viral videos gets out of hand, Grizz, Panda, and Ice Bear embark on a wild road trip to Canada while pursued by Agent Trout.

tt6148376.name: Ben 10 (2016)
tt6148376.description: Ten-year-old Ben Tennyson discovers the Omnitrix during a summer road trip with Grandpa Max and cousin Gwen, unlocking the power to transform into ten alien heroes.

tt9848626.name: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
tt9848626.description: When Van Helsing's mysterious Monsterfication Ray goes haywire, Johnny is turned into a dragon monster while Dracula and his pals are transformed into ordinary humans.

tt1777608.name: Scooby-Doo! Legend of the Phantosaur
tt1777608.description: During a relaxing spa trip in New Mexico, Shaggy is hypnotized into becoming fearless while Mystery Inc. investigates a glowing prehistoric Phantosaur.

tt3819668.name: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'
tt3819668.description: Resurrected by Earth's Dragon Balls, galactic tyrant Frieza trains for the first time in his life to unlock his Golden Frieza form and exact revenge on Goku and Vegeta.

tt1490017.name: The Lego Movie
tt1490017.description: An ordinary LEGO construction worker named Emmet Brickowski, thought to be the prophesied 'Special', is recruited to join a quest to stop the evil tyrant Lord Business.

tt0103408.name: Eek! the Cat
tt0103408.description: Optimistic purple cat Eek lives by the motto 'It never hurts to help!'—even though helping others invariably lands him in hilarious slapstick disasters alongside Sharky the Sharkdog and the Terrible Thunderlizards.

tt0107952.name: The Return of Jafar
tt0107952.description: Escaping from his lamp in the Cave of Wonders as an all-powerful genie, Jafar returns to Agrabah to exact revenge on Aladdin, Jasmine, Genie, and a reformed Iago.

tt3152592.name: Scoob!
tt3152592.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang team up with the Blue Falcon to stop Dick Dastardly from unleashing the ghost dog Cerberus and opening the Underworld.

tt0108903.name: ReBoot
tt0108903.description: Inside the digital metropolis of Mainframe, Guardian Bob, Enzo, and Dot Matrix defend their system from incoming User games and the schemes of viruses Megabyte and Hexadecimal.

tt0369814.name: The Fairly OddParents: Abra-Catastrophe!
tt0369814.description: Celebrating one full year with his fairy godparents Cosmo and Wanda, Timmy Turner receives a magical Rule-Free Muffin that falls into the hands of Mr. Crocker.

tt26925501.name: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
tt26925501.description: Dual protagonists Liko and Roy join the Rising Volt Tacklers aboard an airship to unravel the mysteries of Liko's pendant, the Ancient Poké Ball, and the Pokémon (Pokemon) world.

tt12771340.name: Ben 10 Versus the Universe: The Movie
tt12771340.description: When Vilgax returns to destroy Earth and Ben is accidentally launched into deep space, Ben must stand trial before the Intergalactic Court and unlock the Omni-Naut armor.

tt1327701.name: Ben 10: Alien Swarm
tt1327701.description: Teenage Ben Tennyson, Gwen, and Kevin Levin team up with Elena Validus to stop a hive mind of techno-organic alien microchips from taking over the planet.

tt0413267.name: Shrek the Third
tt0413267.description: Reluctant to become the next King of Far Far Away, Shrek sets out with Donkey and Puss in Boots to bring Princess Fiona's rebellious cousin Artie to the throne while Prince Charming plots a coup.

tt0105928.name: 2 Stupid Dogs
tt0105928.description: Two dim-witted stray dogs—a tiny hyperactive dachshund and a massive laconic sheepdog—wander through misadventures in 1990s suburbia, paired with Secret Squirrel shorts.

tt0348301.name: Atlantis: Milo's Return
tt0348301.description: Milo Thatch and Queen Kida reunite with their surface expedition crew to investigate ancient Atlantean monsters and artifacts awakening across the globe.

tt0268380.name: Ice Age
tt0268380.description: During the onset of the Ice Age, a woolly mammoth named Manny, a talkative sloth named Sid, and a saber-toothed tiger named Diego form an unlikely herd to return a lost human baby.

tt13714610.name: Steven Universe Future
tt13714610.description: After saving the universe and establishing Little Homeschool on Earth, teenage Steven Universe confronts his own unresolved trauma and newly awakening Diamond powers.

tt14614892.name: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
tt14614892.description: When the Red Ribbon Army resurfaces with powerful new androids Gamma 1, Gamma 2, and Cell Max, Piccolo and Gohan unlock new transformations to defend Earth.

tt2277860.name: Finding Dory
tt2277860.description: Friendly but forgetful blue tang fish Dory suddenly remembers her childhood family and sets off across the ocean with Marlin and Nemo to the Marine Life Institute in California.

tt0280030.name: Return to Never Land
tt0280030.description: In World War II London, Wendy's pragmatic daughter Jane refuses to believe in Peter Pan—until Captain Hook mistakes her for Wendy and kidnaps her to Neverland.

tt0074053.name: The Scooby-Doo Show
tt0074053.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Fred, Daphne, and Velma—frequently joined by Scooby's country cousin Scooby-Dum—solve spooky supernatural mysteries across the globe.

tt3655184.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V
tt3655184.description: Aspiring entertainment duelist Yuya Sakaki unlocks Pendulum Summoning and is drawn into an interdimensional war across the Standard, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz dimensions.

tt8723224.name: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us
tt8723224.description: During the annual Wind Festival in Fula City, Ash and Pikachu unite a diverse group of townspeople and the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Zeraora to save the city and Lugia.

tt1985966.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
tt1985966.description: Flint Lockwood and his friends return to Swallow Falls after discovering that his FLDSMDFR machine is still running and creating an ecosystem of living foodimals.

tt0287635.name: Pokémon 4Ever: Celebi - Voice of the Forest
tt0287635.description: Ash, Pikachu, Misty, and Brock meet Sammy, a boy transported forty years forward in time by the mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Celebi, and must protect it from the Iron-Masked Marauder.

tt0479952.name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
tt0479952.description: Attempting to fly back to New York aboard a patched-up plane, Alex, Marty, Melman, Gloria, and the Penguins crash-land on the plains of Africa, where Alex meets his real lion family.

tt0061852.name: The Jungle Book
tt0061852.description: Bagheera the Panther and Baloo the Bear have a difficult time trying to convince a boy named Mowgli to leave the Indian jungle before the evil tiger Shere Khan arrives.

tt1261453.name: Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior
tt1261453.description: Ash, Dawn, and Brock help the Gratitude Pokémon (Pokemon) Shaymin return to the Gracidea flower garden while defending the Reverse World and Giratina from Zero.

tt2850386.name: The Croods: A New Age
tt2850386.description: Searching for a safer habitat, the prehistoric Crood family discovers a walled-in paradise created by the more evolved Betterman family.

tt0120623.name: A Bug's Life
tt0120623.description: A misfit ant named Flik, looking for tough warriors to save his colony from greedy grasshoppers led by Hopper, inadvertently recruits a troupe of circus bugs.

tt0397892.name: Bolt
tt0397892.description: The canine star of a fictional sci-fi action show who believes his superpowers are real embarks on a cross-country trek from New York to Hollywood with alley cat Mittens and hamster Rhino.

tt0106161.name: Tenchi Muyo!
tt0106161.description: Ordinary teenager Tenchi Masaki accidentally awakens space pirate Ryoko and soon finds his rural Japanese shrine home filled with alien princesses, galaxy police, and a genius scientist.

tt3918368.name: Pokémon the Movie: Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction
tt3918368.description: Ash, Serena, Clemont, and Bonnie accompany the Jewel Pokémon (Pokemon) Diancie in search of the Life Pokémon Xerneas before the Destruction Pokémon Yveltal awakens.

tt0057730.name: Jonny Quest (1964)
tt0057730.description: Eleven-year-old Jonny Quest accompanies his scientist father Dr. Benton Quest, bodyguard Race Bannon, adoptive brother Hadji, and bulldog Bandit on high-stakes global adventures.

tt7167686.name: Reign of the Supermen
tt7167686.description: After the death of Superman, four new superpowered figures—Superboy, Steel, the Eradicator, and Cyborg Superman—emerge in Metropolis claiming the mantle of the Man of Steel.

tt2748608.name: Max Steel (2013)
tt2748608.description: Sixteen-year-old Maxwell McGrath discovers he can generate volatile TURBO energy and bonds with alien Ultra-Link Steel to become the armored superhero Max Steel.

tt0481499.name: The Croods
tt0481499.description: After their cave is destroyed, a prehistoric family led by overprotective patriarch Grug embarks on a journey through a fantastical new world with an inventive nomad named Guy.

tt0358082.name: Robots
tt0358082.description: In a world of sentient robots, idealistic young inventor Rodney Copperbottom travels to Robot City to meet his idol Bigweld and teams up with the Rusties to stop corporate tyrant Ratchet.

tt21692408.name: Kung Fu Panda 4
tt21692408.description: Tapped to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace, Po teams up with a quick-witted corsac fox thief named Zhen to stop a shape-shifting sorceress known as The Chameleon.

tt0405537.name: Kronk's New Groove
tt0405537.description: Now the head chef and delivery boy at Mudka's Meat Hut, former henchman Kronk scrambles to acquire a house on the hill before his hard-to-please father Papi visits.

tt0247082.name: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero (1983)
tt0247082.description: Duke, Snake Eyes, Scarlett, and the elite G.I. Joe special mission force defend freedom around the world against Cobra Commander, Destro, and the ruthless terrorist organization Cobra.

tt0042332.name: Cinderella
tt0042332.description: When Cinderella's cruel stepmother prevents her from attending the Royal Ball, she gets some unexpected help from the lovable mice Gus and Jaq and from her Fairy Godmother.

tt15356258.name: Pokémon Evolutions
tt15356258.description: Celebrating 25 years of Pokémon (Pokemon), this eight-episode animated series journeys backward from Galar to Kanto through pivotal moments in Pokémon history.

tt0400717.name: Open Season
tt0400717.description: Pampered 900-pound grizzly bear Boog and fast-talking one-antlered mule deer Elliot find themselves stranded in the woods three days before hunting season opens.

tt0076618.name: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
tt0076618.description: A collection of three classic animated shorts following honey-loving bear Winnie the Pooh, Christopher Robin, Piglet, Tigger, and Eeyore through the Hundred Acre Wood.

tt0138749.name: The Road to El Dorado
tt0138749.description: Two sixteenth-century Spanish con men, Tulio and Miguel, win a map to the legendary City of Gold and are mistaken for gods by the inhabitants of El Dorado.

tt3139086.name: Batman: Assault on Arkham
tt3139086.description: Batman works desperately to find a bomb planted by the Joker while Amanda Waller sends her newly formed Suicide Squad to break into Arkham Asylum to recover vital information.

tt11559400.name: Pokémon Journeys: The Series
tt11559400.description: Ash Ketchum and Pikachu team up with new research fellow Goh to travel across all eight Pokémon (Pokemon) regions while Ash battles his way to the Masters Eight Tournament.

tt8435344.name: ThunderCats Roar
tt8435344.description: Lion-O and the ThunderCats—Tygra, Panthro, Cheetara, WilyKit, and WilyKat—escape the destruction of Thundera and battle Mumm-Ra on Third Earth.

tt5016504.name: Cars 3
tt5016504.description: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast high-tech rookies led by Jackson Storm, Lightning McQueen teams up with eager young race technician Cruz Ramirez to make a comeback.

tt0120630.name: Chicken Run
tt0120630.description: When a cockerel named Rocky apparently flies into a Yorkshire chicken farm, the hens led by Ginger see him as their only hope to escape before Mrs. Tweedy turns them into chicken pies.

tt1911658.name: Penguins of Madagascar
tt1911658.description: Elite undercover flightless birds Skipper, Kowalski, Rico, and Private join forces with the North Wind spy agency to stop villainous octopus Dr. Octavius Brine from taking over the world.

tt0280240.name: The Big O
tt0280240.description: In Paradigm City—a domed metropolis that lost its memories forty years ago—professional Negotiator Roger Smith and android Dorothy pilot the giant mecha Megadeus Big O.

tt0411545.name: Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys
tt0411545.description: In high-tech LaRousse City, an epic clash erupts between the extraterrestrial DNA Pokémon (Pokemon) Deoxys and the sky guardian Rayquaza, trapping Ash and his friends in the crossfire.

tt3521164.name: Moana
tt3521164.description: In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by the Demigod Maui reaches Moana's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out Maui to set things right.

tt0108937.name: Space Ghost Coast to Coast
tt0108937.description: Retired Hanna-Barbera superhero Space Ghost hosts a surreal late-night talk show from the Ghost Planet alongside his former arch-enemies Zorak and Moltar.

tt1323594.name: Despicable Me
tt1323594.description: When a criminal mastermind named Gru uses a trio of orphan girls—Margo, Edith, and Agnes—as pawns for a grand scheme to steal the Moon, he finds their love profoundly changing him.

tt0419739.name: The Fairly OddParents: Channel Chasers
tt0419739.description: Armed with a magic TV remote, Timmy Turner jumps inside the television universe across parody cartoon channels while pursued by evil babysitter Vicky.

tt1731671.name: T.U.F.F. Puppy
tt1731671.description: Dim-witted but enthusiastic dog Dudley Puppy is recruited into the Turbo Undercover Fighting Force (T.U.F.F.) and partnered with top feline agent Kitty Katswell to protect Petropolis.

tt0046183.name: Peter Pan
tt0046183.description: Wendy and her two brothers are whisked away to the magical world of Neverland with the hero of their stories, Peter Pan, and Tinker Bell to face Captain Hook.

tt0313680.name: Tarzan & Jane
tt0313680.description: Celebrating their first anniversary in the African jungle, Jane reminisces with Terk and Tantor about three wild adventures from her first year living with Tarzan.

tt0324941.name: 101 Dalmatians II: Patch's London Adventure
tt0324941.description: Accidentally left behind when the Radcliffe family moves to the countryside, puppy Patch teams up with his TV hero Thunderbolt in London to rescue his siblings from Cruella de Vil.

tt3122180.name: Digimon Fusion
tt3122180.description: Mikey Kudo and his friends are pulled into the Digital World, leading the Fusion Fighters and using the Fusion Loader to combine Shoutmon and ally Digimon against the Bagra Army.

tt0365734.name: Digimon Frontier
tt0365734.description: Five children board a Trailmon to the Digital World and inherit the Legendary Spirits of the ten Ancient Warriors, allowing them to transform directly into Digimon.

tt0837562.name: Hotel Transylvania
tt0837562.description: Count Dracula operates a lavish five-stake resort where monsters can relax away from the human world—until a carefree human backpacker stumbles in and falls for Dracula's daughter Mavis.

tt0809929.name: Winnie the Pooh
tt0809929.description: While searching for a replacement tail for Eeyore, Winnie the Pooh and his friends misread a note from Christopher Robin and set out to rescue him from the imaginary 'Backson'.

tt0892782.name: Monsters vs. Aliens
tt0892782.description: Struck by a radioactive meteor on her wedding day and growing to 49 feet tall, Susan Murphy (Ginormica) is recruited into a secret government team of monsters to stop alien invader Gallaxhar.

tt0159193.name: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing
tt0159193.description: In After Colony 195, five teenage pilots from the space colonies are sent to Earth in advanced Gundams to wage guerrilla warfare against the oppressive OZ organization.

tt10495818.name: The Casagrandes
tt10495818.description: Eleven-year-old Ronnie Anne Santiago and her brother Bobby adjust to life in Great Lakes City living above their family's bodega with their large, loving multigenerational Mexican-American family.

tt3060952.name: Justice League: War
tt3060952.description: The world's finest superheroes—Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Green Lantern, The Flash, Shazam, and Cyborg—meet for the first time to stop an alien invasion led by Darkseid.

tt0266171.name: Outlaw Star
tt0266171.description: Bounty hunter Gene Starwind and his partner Jim Hawking acquire the experimental grappler ship Outlaw Star and a mysterious bio-android named Melfina while searching for the Galactic Leyline.

tt7510222.name: Despicable Me 4
tt7510222.description: Gru, Lucy, Margo, Edith, Agnes, and baby Gru Jr. relocate to the safe-house town of Mayflower while evading escaped French supervillain Maxime Le Mal.

tt26916286.name: Pokémon Concierge
tt26916286.description: At the Pokémon (Pokemon) Resort, new concierge Haru and her Psyduck care for visiting Pokémon guests in this charming stop-motion animated series.

tt0105937.name: Bonkers
tt0105937.description: Washed-up cartoon star Bonkers D. Bobcat joins the Hollywood Police Department's Toon Division alongside grumpy human detective Lucky Piquel.

tt4503906.name: Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages
tt4503906.description: In Dahara City, the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Hoopa's Prison Bottle is broken, unleashing Hoopa Unbound and summoning legendary Pokémon from across space and time.

tt0473050.name: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 2: When Nerds Collide!
tt0473050.description: Jimmy Neutron and Timmy Turner clash over Cindy Vortex while Professor Calamitous and Anti-Cosmo team up to free the anti-fairies.

tt5230922.name: The Powerpuff Girls (2016)
tt5230922.description: Superhero sisters Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup juggle school and saving Townsville from monsters, supervillains, and giant threats.

tt2263944.name: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
tt2263944.description: Awakening from a 39-year slumber, Beerus the God of Destruction travels to Earth in search of the prophesied Super Saiyan God, pushing Goku to a new realm of divine power.

tt0185133.name: Yu Yu Hakusho
tt0185133.description: After dying while saving a child's life, teenage delinquent Yusuke Urameshi is resurrected as Underworld Spirit Detective, battling demons alongside Kuwabara, Hiei, and Kurama.

tt0103373.name: Bobby's World
tt0103373.description: Four-year-old Bobby Generic uses his boundless imagination to navigate family life with his Midwestern parents, siblings, Uncle Ted, and sheepdog Roger.

tt1122505.name: Pokémon: The Rise of Darkrai
tt1122505.description: In Alamos Town, a dimensional battle between the legendary Pokémon (Pokemon) Dialga and Palkia threatens to tear reality apart while the misunderstood Darkrai stands guard.

tt4116284.name: The Lego Batman Movie
tt4116284.description: A cooler-than-ever Bruce Wayne must deal with the usual suspects as they plan to rule Gotham City, while discovering that he has accidentally adopted a teenage orphan who wishes to become Robin.

tt1599351.name: Scooby-Doo! Abracadabra-Doo
tt1599351.description: Mystery Inc. visits Velma's younger sister Madelyn at the Whirlen Merlin Magic Academy, where a giant mythical Gryphon is terrorizing the castle grounds.

tt5113044.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
tt5113044.description: In the 1970s, twelve-year-old Gru schemes to join the supervillain group the Vicious 6 and relies on Kevin, Stuart, Bob, and Otto to rescue him when the heist goes wrong.

tt2267968.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
tt2267968.description: Reunited with his long-lost biological father Li Shan, Po travels to a secret panda village and must train a clumsy community of pandas to defeat the supernatural warrior Kai.

tt0166813.name: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
tt0166813.description: A wild Kiger mustang stallion captured by the U.S. Cavalry forms an unbreakable bond with a young Lakota warrior named Little Creek while fighting to reclaim his freedom.

tt1277953.name: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
tt1277953.description: Hunted across Monte Carlo by relentless animal-control officer Captain Chantel DuBois, Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria hide out by joining a traveling European circus.

tt8856470.name: Pokémon: Mewtwo Strikes Back - Evolution
tt8856470.description: A CGI remake of the classic first Pokémon (Pokemon) movie in which the genetically engineered psychic Pokémon Mewtwo invites Ash, Misty, and Brock to New Island.

tt0307453.name: Shark Tale
tt0307453.description: When a fast-talking whale-wash fish named Oscar falsely takes credit for slaying the son of a shark mob boss, he teams up with vegetarian great white shark Lenny to keep up the ruse.

tt0447854.name: Bambi II
tt0447854.description: After the loss of his mother, young Bambi is raised through the winter by his stoic father, the Great Prince of the Forest, as both learn from one another.

tt6071336.name: Pokémon Generations
tt6071336.description: An 18-part action-packed anthology series exploring untold stories, legendary battles, and villainous plots from across the first six generations of the Pokémon (Pokemon) games.

tt0088632.name: She-Ra: Princess of Power (1985)
tt0088632.description: Princess Adora, twin sister of Prince Adam (He-Man), transforms into She-Ra, Princess of Power, to lead the Great Rebellion against Hordak and the Evil Horde on Etheria.

tt2293640.name: Minions
tt2293640.description: Evolving from single-celled yellow organisms at the dawn of time, Minions Kevin, Stuart, and Bob travel to 1968 London and are recruited by supervillain Scarlet Overkill.

tt0120794.name: The Prince of Egypt
tt0120794.description: Raised as an Egyptian prince alongside his adoptive brother Rameses, Moses discovers his Hebrew heritage and is called upon to lead his people out of slavery.

tt2494376.name: Justice League Dark
tt2494376.description: When innocent civilians begin committing unthinkable crimes across Metropolis and Gotham, Batman recruits John Constantine, Zatanna, Deadman, and Etrigan the Demon.

tt0437503.name: Tarzan II
tt0437503.description: Before becoming King of the Jungle, young Tarzan runs away from his gorilla troop after feeling like an outcast and meets the legendary hermit ape Zugor on Dark Mountain.

tt1107365.name: Open Season 2
tt1107365.description: When Mr. Weenie is kidnapped by a group of pampered domestic pets led by Fifi the poodle, Boog, Elliot, McSquizzy, and the forest animals go undercover to rescue him.

tt1667889.name: Ice Age: Continental Drift
tt1667889.description: After Scrat's pursuit of his acorn triggers a continental cataclysm, Manny, Diego, and Sid are set adrift on an iceberg and clash with Captain Gutt's crew of seafaring pirates.

tt0122365.name: Wacky Races (1968)
tt0122365.description: Eleven eccentric racers—including Penelope Pitstop, Peter Perfect, the Ant Hill Mob, and scheming villain Dick Dastardly with his snickering dog Muttley—compete in cross-country road rallies.

tt0098763.name: Captain Planet and the Planeteers
tt0098763.description: Gaia, the spirit of the Earth, grants five magic elemental rings to youths from across the globe who combine their powers to summon environmental superhero Captain Planet.

tt7167658.name: The Death of Superman
tt7167658.description: When a hulking monster named Doomsday arrives on Earth and begins a mindless rampage across Metropolis, the Justice League falls and only Superman can stand in its way.

tt15248880.name: Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake
tt15248880.description: Fionna Campbell and her magical cat Cake travel across the multiverse alongside former Ice King Simon Petrikov while evading a powerful cosmic auditor.

tt3470600.name: Despicable Me 3
tt3470600.description: Gru meets his long-lost charming, cheerful, and more successful twin brother Dru, who wants to team up with him for one last criminal heist against former child star Balthazar Bratt.

tt0097757.name: The Little Mermaid
tt0097757.description: Mermaid princess Ariel makes a Faustian bargain with the sea witch Ursula, trading her voice for human legs in hopes of winning the heart of Prince Eric on land.

tt6595896.name: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!
tt6595896.description: Retelling the beginning of Ash Ketchum and Pikachu's bond, the duo sets out from Pallet Town with a Rainbow Wing to meet the legendary Pokémon (Pokemon) Ho-Oh at Mount Tensei.

tt0086824.name: Voltron: Defender of the Universe (1984)
tt0086824.description: Five young space explorers pilot robotic lions that combine to form Voltron, the mighty super-robot defender of the peaceful planet Arus against King Zarkon's Robeasts.

tt2096673.name: Inside Out
tt2096673.description: After young Riley is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions—Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness—conflict on how best to navigate a new city.

tt0251439.name: Trigun
tt0251439.description: Across the desert planet Gunsmoke, pacifist gunman Vash the Stampede—known as the Humanoid Typhoon with a 60-billion-double-dollar bounty—tries to uphold peace and love while pursued by assassins.

tt1964547.name: Pokémon the Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram
tt1964547.description: In Eindoak Town, Ash, Iris, and Cilan befriend the Victory Pokémon (Pokemon) Victini and call upon the legendary dragon Reshiram to save the Sword of the Vale.

tt0451079.name: Horton Hears a Who!
tt0451079.description: Horton the Elephant hears a faint cry for help coming from a microscopic speck of dust floating through the air and vows to protect the tiny community of Whoville inside it.
